decision: Do not spend the frozen cap2 on this candidate. Preserve original protocol and literal replay pass; record the independent rejection separately. No parameter adjustment or reinterpretation to rescue this candidate.

literal_protocol_result.reason: The effect clause compares a capped 2.4m prefix with a 2.7m initial reverse segment. Truncation guarantees apparent improvement even when the global route keeps exactly the same initial reversal.

strengths: The new full-map goal search is a distinct planning mechanism; it uses the existing measured primitives, costs, initial-direction eligibility and observed-map inflation.
Both actual drivers differ only by the planning wrapper plus arm identity, protocol path and output path. Source, pose adapter, tracker and low-level controller compositions are preserved.

The wrapper copies the FirstPrimitiveDirection boundary namespace, retaining its class closure. That boundary still delegates to the original continuous tube retention and installation transaction. No second act or shared-global patch is introduced.
Failure returns the same baseline plan object. Existing recorded MRO checks cover single installation, retain without rebuild, mocked exact fallback and passing the two forward primitives constraint.

All 20 replay input hashes still match; all ten saved baseline waypoints and expanded-node counts match the replay baseline records. The saved replay reports all ten full paths pass sampled current-map clearance.
No new online truth input was found. Ground-truth depth/pose diagnostics remain outside the planner/source feedback, with the inherited initial gauge and ideal low-level IMU privileges disclosed.

important_issues.title: Admission accepts reverse reduction caused solely by clipping the route
important_issues.impact: The selected prefix removes the ninth reverse primitive and the later cusp from the metric without changing the global search decision at the designated boundary. The literal pass therefore fails to establish the proposed less-reversing mechanism and cannot justify the physical pair.
important_issues.recommendation: Reject this version before physical launch under an explicit anti-false-positive scientific review. Keep the frozen protocol and replay unchanged; do not alter prefix length, costs, node budget or evaluation frame to rescue the result.

semantic_checks.novelty: Full-map direct goal search genuinely differs from the inherited holonomic subgoal and cropped search. This is not evidence of benefit by itself.
semantic_checks.frame60: First eight outgoing waypoints differ from baseline, establishing a genuine path-selection intervention. This does not establish reduced reversal at the preregistered frame175 or counterfactual later navigation improvement.
semantic_checks.frame660: Full route removes a later baseline cusp at this saved input. This is an exploratory observation and does not replace the frozen frame175 effect criterion.
semantic_checks.prefix_terminal: global_guidance.py:14 sets terminal direction equal to the incoming segment and zeroes commands. This agrees with the original reconstruction convention and excludes artificial terminal cusps from the count.
semantic_checks.prefix_execution: A terminal zero marker is not a physical stop guarantee. benchmark/policies.py:737-751 reuses the preceding command in the same direction; its remaining-path calculation and goal_braking condition handle stopping. The inherited reference_geometry_status rejects retention when remaining arc is below 0.5m, so clipping also advances rebuilding and changes available cusp/lookahead information. These are additional effects of reference clipping, not demonstrated improvements in global route choice.
semantic_checks.retention: The code and recorded MRO checks preserve retention logic and tracker state. Changing path length naturally changes retention decisions; no claim of identical decisions is warranted.
semantic_checks.first_direction: The new global search receives initial_direction and first_primitive_direction unchanged; the same planner restricts its initial two primitives when a direction is supplied.
semantic_checks.unknown: Labels are not rewritten; unknown remains -1 and is traversable only under inherited controlled exploration. The actual ViewpointConfirmationGrid contains hazard/unknown labels, all ten baseline unknown_fraction values are 1.0, and setting result unknown_fraction=1.0 therefore introduces no extra command cap difference for this domain.
semantic_checks.truth: No added truth-based path, occupancy or current pose source was found in the wrapper or driver diff. Runtime goal/contact termination and offline diagnostic truth remain inherited; this is conditional task scoring, not a pure RGB claim.

validation_scope.independent_checks: Read-only source inspection, actual driver diff, saved JSON arithmetic and SHA256 checks. Did not rerun the search, MRO test or any physics.
validation_scope.parent_recorded_checks: Read mro_check.py, mro_checks.json, mro_check.log, replay.py, replay.json, replay.log and check.py; recorded passes are treated as evidence with their stated scope.
validation_scope.limitations: The existing prefix unit check verifies waypoint shape and counts; the MRO check exercises boundaries and a mocked fallback. Neither executes the tracker over prefix endpoints or proves shorter physical reversal.
validation_scope.git: Workspace has no resolvable HEAD; reviewed explicit files and hashes instead of a commit range.
